Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl

Class StagingResourceResolver

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.AbstractStagingResourceResolver
      • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.StagingResourceResolver
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Closeable, AutoCloseable, org.apache.sling.api.adapter.Adaptable, org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver
    public class StagingResourceResolver
extends AbstractStagingResourceResolver
implements org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver

    A ResourceResolver that provides transparent access to releases as defined in StagingReleaseManager. This is always instantiated through StagingReleaseManager.getResolverForRelease(Release, ReleaseMapper, boolean).

    Limitations:

    • This returns read-only resources, and querying is only supported through QueryBuilder.
    • We also don't support ParsedParameters (yet).
    • We don't include synthetic resources or resources of other resource providers (servlets etc.) into releases.

        Additionally, we support adapting to the specific type of this resolver, to easily pierce through ResourceResolverWrappers. CAUTION: we have to support the JCR Session here, since it's often used to access various managers, but the session does not support our simulated resources. Use at your own risk.
